corrections.was: script raises the end movie 0089a480 -> 0089a390 -> 004cd390; OnMove polls 004d7ea0 and enqueues state request 0Fh; the drain dispatches 0Fh to 004d7970
corrections.is: 0089a390 calls 004d7970 itself at 0089a469 whenever the script's goToDebrief byte is set, so a PlayBinkMovie(name, true) issued in game state 0Dh reaches EndScene synchronously and EndScene enqueues 10h at 004d7aec. The poll's own 0Fh arm is then unreachable, because 004d7ea0's first test (004d7ea4) requires an empty request queue and 10h is already in it
corrections.evidence: the decompiled body of 0089a390 (BSP_NativeString_Resize(7,1), concat, CALL 004cd390 at 0089a40e, then TEST BL,BL at 0089a45c and CALL 004d7970 at 0089a469); run log local/game_run_2g.log, where MissionFrame::check_mission_completion ran 90 times and MissionCompletion::mission_result was read 89 times, the missing one being the frame the injection ran on

corrections.target: docs/GAME_FRAME_CONTROL.md, "the full lifecycle of the drain suspension is not closed"
corrections.was: game+5ECh is cleared by 004c7ed0 and written by 004ddb90; neither was analyzed; only the state 11h arm was shown to clear it
corrections.is: both sites that latch game+5ECh also register the routine that clears it: 004d7f42 (the poll) and 004e4763 (the teardown arm) call 004f8970 with 004f89d0, and 004f89d0 calls 004c7ed0, whose 004c7efe clears game+5ECh and whose 004c7ed7 clears game+7184h. The state 11h arm at 004e506b is the second clear and it only fires while game+7184h is clear, so a movie in flight holds the suspension until its completion runs
corrections.evidence: disassembly of 004f89d0 (004f89eb CALL 004c7ed0), of 004c7ed0 (004c7ed7 and 004c7efe) and of 004e504b..004e5087

corrections.target: docs/MISSION_RESULT_DECISION.md uncertainty "004cd390's +8h float comes from 00ce77e4; the constant's value was not read", and bsp::MissionResult::score in include/bsp/game_frame_control.hpp

corrections.was: the teardown arm 004e458a: leaves state 11h at 004e4778, enqueues 04h at 004e47a7 when the queue is empty
corrections.is: the two are alternative branches, not a sequence. 004e4722 tests game+7188h: with a result object the arm plays it (004e474a), registers the completion (004e4763), closes the result GUI (004e476c), releases the result (004e4773), writes state 11h (004e4778), raises the drain suspension (004e4782) and jumps over the enqueue at 004e4789; with no result object it falls to 004e478b and enqueues 04h only when the queue is empty. corrections.was: BSP_Game_OnMove has an 8-byte body, so tools/verify_report_calls.py reports call sites inside it as "in no Ghidra function"
corrections.is: the stored body is now 004e4a40-004e5537, so the defect no longer affects this report; the repair script has run since milestone 2f

executable_decisions: --mission-complete-frame N makes the call a mission script's PlayBinkMovie(name, true) makes, because no script on this installation reaches it in a headless run with no enemy contact. The movie name is the scene's own short name; everything after the call is recovered behaviour.

The end movie is never played: 004f8a20 needs the GUI movie widget, which is the front-end owner's. Both call sites are records, and game+7184h is therefore never raised, which is why the state 11h arm lowers the suspension on the same frame.
The scoring record the commit writes is the zeroed one the load produced. Scoring_SetMissionCompleted 008b8ad0 is the script's and this mission's stage init never reaches it.
The drain's request 04h is recorded rather than dispatched into another owner's shell, and the run then requests the application loop exit through the same byte --frames uses.

The fixed step's tail hook 00875fd1 is run by the executable at the driver's own tail position, because bsp::run_fixed_step_driver_00875bb0 stops after the interpolation wave and carries no host method for it.
